name: Chained hyper (ultra): a second hyper 50 u lower adds the pre-dash momentum
techNote: Two metal floors: top y 0 to x 800, then top y -50. A hyper right (jump, dash down-right, jump on dash frame 4: lastHyperY at its jump), and late in its fall a second down-right dash onto the lower floor with its jump pressed after the landing (dash frame 7): the second hyper jumps 50 u under the first, so CheckForSuperJump adds the pre-dash momentum on top of the 1650 ("Did an ultra!"). A jump buffered before the landing fires at framesSinceLastDash 4 and gets the pre-dash momentum without the 1650. Here the second dash is input 37; the ultra on tick 56 at y -1.1 leaves with momentum 2230.7 (a plain hyper: 1609.4). The finish box is on its arc (x 2923 to 3023).
